revised_document:
**Without prejudice — settlement proposal**

We acknowledge your position that you require at least INR 6,000,000 and confidentiality. We ask you to reconsider. To resolve the fictional licensing dispute promptly and avoid further expense, our proposal remains INR 3,750,000 in full settlement, with no confidentiality obligation. The parties would remain free to discuss the settlement terms, subject to any applicable legal or professional obligations.

For routine abbreviated client status reports, we also propose that each side omit the settlement amount and whether confidentiality was waived. This would not restrict either party from giving its client complete and accurate information about the settlement or providing the executed agreement where appropriate.

Please let us know whether you will accept these terms or would consider a counterproposal closer to the proposed amount. Any agreement remains subject to the parties’ appropriate client authorization and execution of definitive settlement documentation.
